integrity: The theorem is given with a self-contained Fano-incidence proof and two standard-library exhaustive checks, both run against extracted embedded source files. No independent audit or external certification has occurred.
scientific_limitations: A finite complete classification confined to seven positions, binary linear Hamming codes and cyclic width-two pair reads. The Fano cycle count is not claimed to have independently confirmed historical priority. No all-length or physical performance inference.
title: Exact symbol-pair spectra of all length-seven binary Hamming interleavers
